content: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
And the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep.
Then God said, ','Let there be light,',', and there was light.
And God saw that the light was good.

content.text: And He separated the light from the darkness.

content: God called the light ','day',', and the darkness He called ','night,'.
